title: Tracking 504 student under the FOF
description: Tracking 504 student under the FOF - Gives a list of students with a 504 plan and includes counseor last name.
code: LIST STU FOF TCH STU.ID STU.LN STU.FN STU.GR TCH.TE FOF.SD FOF.RD BY TCH.TE IF ( 504_PLAN = YES OR 504_PRG = YES ) AND STU.TG = " "
